normal.name: NewClassicGaming
normal.text: The tapes survived. That didn't mean the games were saved. EA recovered original Wing Commander and Road Rash footage. Getting it back into playable games took fan patches, help from GOG, and relicensing Road Rash’s music. EA's archive finally met years of fan work. What would you save first: original builds, master footage, music, or fan fixes? https://newclassicgaming.com/d/128-ea-found-the-master-tapes-fans-made-them-matter-again #GamePreservation #RetroGaming

normal.name: Dr. G. Power
normal.text: OK. 281400 points on #DigDug. I'm playing on my 2600+ with an ArcadeR with a real Sanwa stick and a square gate. I'm starting to think if I rotare the gate to a diamond or use a plus gate as well as a screen overlay for the grid I could get to 500k points. I loving revisiting this childhood game so much!!! I also want to play it more on vintage hardware and not the 2600+ so much. I'll try it on my light sixer more often. #retrogaming #atari #atari2600

normal.name: Italian Skeleton
normal.text: I want to unwind from point and clicks, so I've gone to another of my comfort zone genres: #realtimestrategy with #KingdomUnderFire a war of heroes as my next game Kind of like Warcraft 3, it blends rts with rpg mechanics, unlike it though, it keeps in separated compartments, meaning that you cannot change the gear of your heroes during the strategy maps, only in the rpg ones #gaming #videogames #pcgaming #retrogaming
